basic_profile.bio: Having been a part of the Reddit community for over seven years, I am a curious mind constantly in pursuit of knowledge. My journey began with an interest in educational content, especially mathematics and technology. I hold a degree in Computer Science and have a penchant for self-learning. Currently located in the UK, I am an IT consultant by day and a lifelong learner by night. My interests range from machine learning to automobile engineering, with a recent fascination for Euro Truck Simulator 2. I typically browse Reddit during evening hours after work. In a committed relationship, I often share my learning experiences with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a solid foundation in Computer Science, I have expanded my knowledge through various online courses, focusing on machine learning and applied mathematics. My work as an IT consultant allows me to apply theoretical knowledge in practical scenarios, keeping me updated with the latest technological advancements.
